title: This OpenAI product manager always asks ChatGPT to 'impress' him. Here’s his advice for AI prompts.
excerpt: OpenAI product manager Ty Geri told Business Insider that he sends long rambles to ChatGPT Work to figure out what's "sticking."
content_html:
By Henry Chandonnet

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Ty Geri always tells ChatGPT: "Please impress me."

"You shouldn't have to," said Geri, a product manager at OpenAI. "The models should try to impress you regardless."

Geri joined OpenAI last year after working at Google on AI search products, like its AI overviews. The 28-year-old from San Francisco is on the front lines of AI and shared with Business Insider how he uses it most effectively at work.

That includes asking it to be impressive — though he wasn't sure it helped much. "It could definitely just be in my head at this point," he said.

His other strategy: long rants. "When I'm thinking something through, I put on dictation, and I ramble," he said. He described ChatGPT as his "partner," one that can sort through his thoughts and find what's "sticking."

Geri will enter one of OpenAI's meeting rooms, turn on his work phone, and start talking to it. "Some people probably think I'm doing something important, but I'm just talking to ChatGPT Work," he said.

He shares the strategy with another OpenAI alum: Andrej Karpathy, a founding member of the lab who later worked at Tesla and recently joined Anthropic. Karpathy wrote in July that he liked 10-minute voice sessions with an LLM that were a "total mess, anything goes, full stream of consciousness."

Still, Geri said he hoped users eventually wouldn't need to have prompting strategies at all. There were areas that OpenAI needed to get better at — "Our writing quality, I think we need to improve," he said — but things should just work.

Product manager gigs are common across tech, offering high salaries without requiring engineering experience. Still, the role is rapidly evolving in the age of AI, as PMs gain access to new skills through vibe-coding tools.

The primary job of a product manager hasn't changed, Geri said: to "care the most about the product." What has changed, then, is the PM's ability to "take action," he said.

"Once upon a time, a PM would strictly have to work with a data scientist," he said. "Now, it's so much more fluid and dynamic."

While the products are "empowering," Geri said, they also "take away a lot of excuses that we used to have." PMs could once say that they didn't understand a certain stage of the engineering process, or that they didn't get all the technicalities. No more.

His advice to other PMs: "Don't restrict what you can understand or can do anymore. You really can do anything."

At OpenAI, PMs are often shipping code, he said. Jobs don't end and start in specific, discrete places. People may have "spikes," sure, but they all share a common goal and means of achieving it.

"Our job is to care about the user and bring the best experience to the user," he said. "We should do whatever it takes to make that happen."

作者：Henry Chandonnet 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

Ty Geri 总是告诉 ChatGPT：“请给我留下深刻的印象。”

“你不应该这样做，”OpenAI 的产品经理 Geri 说。 “无论如何，模特应该努力给你留下深刻的印象。”

Geri 去年加入 OpenAI，此前他在 Google 从事人工智能搜索产品（例如人工智能概述）的工作。 这位来自旧金山的 28 岁年轻人处于人工智能的前沿，他与 Business Insider 分享了他如何在工作中最有效地使用人工智能。

这包括要求它令人印象深刻——尽管他不确定这有多大帮助。 “此时此刻，这肯定只是在我的脑海中，”他说。

他的另一个策略是：长篇大论。 “当我思考某件事时，我会听写，然后胡言乱语，”他说。 他将 ChatGPT 描述为他的“伙伴”，可以整理他的想法并找到“坚持”的东西。

Geri 将进入 OpenAI 的一间会议室，打开他的工作电话，并开始与其交谈。 “有些人可能认为我正在做一些重要的事情，但我只是在与 ChatGPT Work 交谈，”他说。

他与另一位 OpenAI 校友 Andrej Karpathy 分享了这一策略，Andrej Karpathy 是该实验室的创始成员，后来在 Tesla 工作，最近加入了 Anthropic。 卡帕蒂在 7 月份写道，他喜欢与法学硕士进行 10 分钟的语音课程，“完全混乱，任何事情都可以，完全是意识流”。

不过，杰里表示，他希望用户最终根本不需要提示策略。 OpenAI 在某些领域需要做得更好——“我认为我们的写作质量需要提高，”他说——但事情应该会顺利进行。

产品经理的职位在科技领域很常见，提供高薪而不需要工程经验。 尽管如此，随着产品经理通过氛围编码工具获得新技能，这个角色在人工智能时代正在迅速发展。

Geri 表示，产品经理的主要工作没有改变：“最关心产品”。 他说，改变的是总理“采取行动”的能力。

“曾几何时，产品经理必须严格与数据科学家合作，”他说。 “现在，它更加流畅和动态。”

杰里说，虽然这些产品“赋予了我们力量”，但它们也“消除了我们过去的很多借口”。 产品经理曾经可能会说他们不了解工程流程的某个阶段，或者他们没有掌握所有的技术细节。 不再。

他对其他产品经理的建议是：“不要再限制你能理解或能做的事情。 你真的可以做任何事情。”

他说，在 OpenAI，项目经理通常负责交付代码。 工作不会在特定的、离散的地方结束和开始。 当然，人们可能会有“尖峰”，但他们都有一个共同的目标和实现目标的方法。

“我们的工作就是关心用户，给用户带来最好的体验，”他说。 “我们应该尽一切努力来实现这一目标。”
